name: Kousoukenki Arch Braver - Mazoku Henhou
original_name: 光装剣姫アークブレイバー 魔族篇胞
source: Modern society is in state of peace and prosperity thanks to advancements in civilization and science. Sumiki Sumi, a female student attending the Goeiji Academy, lives alone in the school's dormitory after losing her parents at a young age. One day, she encounters monstrous beings attacking humans. Despite her fear, Sumi decides to save people from those hideous things. In this time of crisis, a plush-like creature named Kuunerii appears before her and gives her an item called a Light Gear. Sumi is chosen by the Light Gear called Alexandros, and transforms into the hero of light, Arch Brave. She decides to confront the invading demons known as the Arch Erimos with her newfound powers. Meanwhile, Ladiesthor is leading the demons' army and decides to obtain the newly transformed Arch Brave.
translation: 文明与科学的进步，让现代社会享有和平与繁荣。就读于御江慈学园的女生清木澄，自幼失去双亲，独自在学校宿舍生活。一天，她遭遇了袭击人类的异形生物。尽管心怀恐惧，澄仍决心从那些丑陋的怪物手中救下人们。危急之际，一个形似玩偶、自称库内莉的生物出现在她面前，交给她一件名为“光装具”的道具。被光装具“亚历山德罗斯”选中的澄，变身成为光之勇者“Arch Braver”。获得新力量后，她决定对抗以“Arch Erimos”之名入侵世界的魔族。与此同时，率领魔族大军的拉迪托尔也开始暗中行动，打算将刚刚变身的她据为己有。
